scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "cargo run --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml"
scripts.dev:host: npx concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host" "cargo run --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && cargo build --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --release
